flows.description: Flows in tour order: behaviour by importance, LLM-classified refactors, LLM-classified tests.

quiet.description: Quiet rows, always after the flows.

threads.description: Every GitHub review thread of the pull request.

review_ready.description: Plan and PR context are accepted; analysed flows can be reviewed while work continues.

background_analysis.description: Whether unrequested flows are analysed in rank order.

models_used.description: Distinct model choices of jobs actually claimed, in first-use order.

usage.description: Provider-reported totals of finished jobs; null without reports.

progress.description: Whole-run progress derived from existing jobs and documents, absent on older servers.

has_my_state.description: Whether this reader has saved review state (including explicitly empty state).

pr.description: The pull request as analysed (its head is the analysis head).

finished_at.description: When it finished, failed or was cancelled.

oneOf.description: High effort (v1 default for every job kind).

UsageTotals.description: Token sums; cached input is included in input, not additional to it.

reasoning_output_tokens.description: Unknown: the retained job-result contract does not store reasoning tokens separately.

jobs.description: Finished jobs with a provider usage report, including Ask and all analysis rounds.

AnalysisProgress.description: Whole-analysis waiting progress, never review completion or confidence.

started_at.description: Start of this run, preserved across parts and server restarts.

flows.description: Flows completed; total unknown until the plan is accepted.

estimate.description:
Estimated remaining time; null without sufficient observations, or while paused/terminal. With background
analysis off it covers plan and PR context only and is null once the review is ready.

percent.description:
Overall waiting progress, 0..=100; null until a denominator can be estimated or counted. With background
analysis off it covers plan and PR context only and is null once the review is ready (until finished).

RunStage.description: One stage in the short whole-run list.

done.description: Accepted units, not attempts (repairs do not count twice).

state.description: Position relative to the currently executing stage.

RunStageState.description: State of a whole-run stage; pause/failure remain on AnalysisState.

AnalysisEstimate.description: A bounded estimate, not a deadline or a guarantee.

remaining_seconds.description: Remaining seconds, never more than seven days.

basis.description: Strongest observation used; before planning ends the flow component is only line-based.

rough.description: True while the flow count is unknown and estimated from changed lines.

oneOf.description: Uses completed plan parts or flows of this run, with history for unstarted kinds.
Uses recent completed runs with known unit counts.
Only historical time per changed line; the flow count is not known yet.

AnalysisId.description: Identifier of an analysis (one per pull request, head commit and LLM language).

PrSummary.description: A pull request as GitHub reports it.

CommitSha.description: A full 40-character hexadecimal git commit id.

oneOf.description: Planning flows; the number of flows is not known yet.

stage.description: The current stage; absent when no job of the analysis is queued, running or paused.

idle.description:
True when flows remain but none is admitted (none requested, background analysis off or the rest
failed for good): nothing is analysed until a flow is requested or background analysis is switched on.

stage.description: The current stage; absent when no job of the analysis is queued, running or paused.

oneOf.description: Waiting for the user or the provider usage limit.

reason.description: User pause takes precedence over a provider usage limit.

paused_at.description: When the user requested the pause.

total.description: Flows in total; null while planning (the number of flows is not known yet).

stage.description: The stage that resumes; absent when no job of the analysis is queued, running or paused.

oneOf.description: Failed; configuration problems require administrator action before another attempt.

reason.description: Typed cause when known; absent on older failures.

flow.description: The flow that failed, or null when it failed before any flow existed.

oneOf.description: Every flow analysed; the review can open.

AnalysisStage.description:
The stage of the analysis's live job (the queued, running or paused job of its current round); only facts the
server knows, no estimate.

part.description: Current planning part; present only for a multi-part plan.

flow.description: The flow analysed (`flow` only); absent when the stored plan does not list it.

started_at.description: When the server handed the job to the runner; null while the job waits for the runner.

PlanPart.description: Position within the fixed plan batches of this run.

total.description: Total parts, fixed before the first plan job is submitted.

index.description: 1-based position of the flow in the stored plan (the order flows are analysed in).

PauseReason.description: Why an analysis waits; absent reasons in older responses mean a usage limit.

oneOf.description: The user decides when to resume.
The provider decides when a job may run again.
The GitHub login is not allowed to sign in.
The resource does not exist or is not visible.
The URL is not a GitHub pull request URL.
The repository is private (v1 supports public repositories only).
The GitHub App is not installed where it is needed.
The analysis has not finished yet.
The request conflicts with the current state.
The pull request head moved since the analysis.
The pending comment was published on GitHub meanwhile; the edit or deletion applied to the published one.
The requested line range is too large.
The file is not rendered (generated material).
GitHub did not answer as expected.
The server is busy (e.g. its database is locked); retry after `Retry-After`.
A dashboard refresh of the user is already scanning (R2), or live (R4).
GitHub's rate limit for the user's token is reached; the message names the reset time.
Dashboard settings break a rule; the message names the field and the rule.
The list changed since the cursor was issued; read it again from the start.
The access token lacks the scope the route needs.
The route does not accept access tokens.
The user has the maximum number of live access tokens.

FlowRef.description: A flow named in a state message.

FlowId.description: Identifier of a flow, assigned by the `plan` job: `f1`, `f2`, ….

PrContextBlock.description: The PR context: deterministic facts and LLM content.

PrContextFacts.description: Deterministic facts of the PR context.

related_work_links.description: Structured GitHub targets resolved independently of the agent's prose; missing on older Tours.

memcan_status.description: Current observed MemCan connection state, separate from the analysis's profile lookup.

ci.description: CI status of the head commit.

threads_status.description: Whether `Tour.threads` holds every review thread of the pull request.

project_profile.description: Where the project profile came from.

agent_instruction_files.description:
Paths in the pull request diff that look like agent instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, `.agents/`,
`.codex/`, `.claude/`, `.cursor*`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`); shown as a notice, empty = none.

related_work_checked.description:
False when related work could not be looked up (the GitHub App is not installed on the repository);
the related-work list then reads "not checked".

step_count.description: Number of steps over all flows.

RelatedWorkLink.description: A validated target syntax and the result of checking it against GitHub.

reference.description: Exact reference in the agent output, used only to associate the item.

repo.description: Repository in owner/name form, validated by the server.

number.description: Positive GitHub issue or pull request number.

kind.description: Resource kind, from GitHub when verified, otherwise inferred from the reference.

verified.description: GitHub confirmed the resource exists and its kind; false if it could not be read.

RelatedWorkTargetKind.description: GitHub resource linked from related work (distinct from the LLM's relationship kind).

MemcanStatus.description: Most recent observed MemCan connectivity; never an on-demand health probe.

state.description: Outcome observed by the server's client.

last_success_at.description: Last successful tool call in this server process, retained after a later failure.

MemcanState.description: What the server knows about MemCan connectivity.

oneOf.description: Configured, but no completed attempt since this server started.
The most recent attempt reached MemCan.
The most recent attempt could not reach MemCan or timed out.

CiStatus.description: CI status of the head commit: its check runs and its commit statuses.

total.description: Number of checks read: check runs plus commit statuses.

failing.description: Failing checks (check runs and commit statuses).

check_runs.description: Check runs by outcome; absent when the check runs were not read.

statuses.description: Commit statuses (latest per context) by outcome; absent when the statuses were not read.

oneOf.description: Both sources were read and every check run and commit status concluded `success`.

Every check read has concluded and none failed, but not every one succeeded (some skipped or neutral) or
one source was not read: never "all passing".
No checks reported for the head commit.
The check runs could not be read (no GitHub token, GitHub error or rate limit); nothing is claimed.

url.description: Link to the check, if any.

failing_tests.description: Names of failing tests, when the check reports them.

CiCounts.description: Checks of one CI source by outcome.

pending.description: Not concluded yet (queued, in progress, a `pending` status).

skipped.description: Concluded `skipped` (check runs only): did not run.

ThreadsStatus.description: How completely the pull request's review threads were read.

oneOf.description: Only the first threads were read (the server's read cap); more exist on GitHub.
The threads could not be read (no token, GitHub error or rate limit).

Counters.description: Counters over material that is not analysed.

lines_added_to_tests.description: Added diff lines in deterministically classified test files; not an assertion or test-function count.

lines_removed_from_tests.description: Removed diff lines from test files, including replacements; label as "changed or removed".

dependency_files_not_checked.description:
Changed dependency files whose dependencies were not checked (other ecosystems, unreadable or unparsable
files); their changes are not counted in `dependencies_changed`.

ProjectProfileStatus.description: Sources of the project profile; empty with MemCan `checked` means no profile (ratings are component-level).

memcan.description:
Whether MemCan was searched for a `type: project-profile` memory; `not_checked` means a MemCan profile
may exist that `sources` does not list.

ProfileSource.description: A source of the project profile.

oneOf.description: The source was not read; nothing is claimed about it.

PrContextOutput.description: The pull request at project scale.

problem.description: The problem the pull request solves.

what_it_gives.description: What the change gives users or developers.

related_work.description: Related pull requests, issues or mechanisms; may be empty.

fit_questions.description: Questions about the fit of the change, never verdicts.

reference.description: URL or `owner/repo#number` of the related item.

overlap.description: One line on the overlap with this pull request.

RelatedWorkKind.description: Kind of related work in the PR context.

oneOf.description: A competing solution to the same problem.
A pull request stacked on or under this one.
An issue linked to this change.
A matching change in a companion repository.

FitQuestion.description: A question about the fit of the change at project scale.

question.description: The question, phrased as a question.

evidence.description: Lines read that motivate the question.

Evidence.description: A line the agent actually read and cites as evidence.

side.description: head for the checked-out code; base only for removed code read from the base commit.

LineSide.description:
Commit a line number refers to. Head is the common case (final code); base only for code that no longer
exists at the head commit (a deleted file, an emptied file, removed lines without a head line to anchor to).

oneOf.description: Lines of the base commit (removed code).

analysis_status.description: Present on lazy Tours; absent on older finished Tours.

planned.description: Plan metadata and deterministic ranges, available before step analysis.

group.description: Ordering group and menu label, derived from the classification.

graph.description: Flow graph; nodes derived by the server from the steps.

FlowAnalysisStatus.description: Work status, separate from risk or the reviewer's ticks.

started_at.description: Runner claim time for the current attempt, if any.

message.description: Plain failure description; never provider output.

oneOf.description: Requested, queued or waiting for a provider limit.
The attempt or its repairs failed; explicit retry is possible.

PlannedFlowDetails.description: Information from the accepted plan, before step analysis.

ranges.description: Changed ranges assigned by the verified plan.

FileRanges.description: Several line ranges of one file on one side.

LineRange.description: Lines `start_line..=end_line`, 1-based, on the side given by the enclosing type.

FlowGroup.description: Ordering group of a flow (brief §4.3 flow order).

files.description: Files touched by the flow's steps.

risk.description: Highest band of the step assessments; null when no step is assessed.

Classification.description: Classification of a flow (brief §3, closed list).

oneOf.description: Changes a public API or contract.

RiskBand.description: Risk at system scale, rated by the LLM (no numbers, brief §1).

oneOf.description: Noticeable in some situations or by some users.
A production user or operator would clearly notice.

problem_before.description: Problem before this pull request: the local trigger and what was wrong or missing.

change.description: The intended correction this pull request makes.

example_before_after.description: A short concrete example of behaviour before and after.

PatternRepetition.description: A pattern explained once and applied in several places ("same pattern × N").

StepId.description: Identifier of a step, assigned by the server in step order: `"<flow>.<n>"`, e.g. `f2.3`.

PatternSite.description: One place where a repeated pattern is applied.

step_id.description: The step containing these lines, if any.

FlowGraph.description: A flow graph: nodes are steps.

GraphNode.description: A graph node, the diagram twin of one step.

NodeKind.description: Kind of a flow-graph node, derived from the step kind.

label.description: Branch label (decision outcome, loop back-edge, error exit).

file.description: Repository-relative path on the step's side.

side.description: `head` normally; `base` for removed code without a head location (deleted or emptied file).

github_url.description: GitHub link to the lines at the head commit (base commit for a base-side step).

changed_lines.description: Changed lines inside the step: added lines of a head step, removed lines of a base step.

moved.description: Move check result, for steps whose code was moved.

call_hierarchy.description: Callers and callees from the tech plugin; null in v1 ("n/a — needs a language plugin").

thread_ids.description: Ids of the GitHub threads located in this step.

MoveFact.description: Result of the deterministic move check.

from.description: The original block at the base commit.

badge.description: `text_identical` when no line differs after whitespace normalisation, else null.

differing_lines.description: Number of lines that differ from the original.

FileRange.description: A line range of one file.

ProvenanceBadge.description: A deterministic check that a badge names (brief §1, §3). No badge means LLM analysis.

oneOf.description: Moved block equal to its original after whitespace normalisation.
Git treats the file as binary (content check); it is not shown or analysed.

CallHierarchy.description: Callers and callees of a step symbol.

assessment.description: Assessment, collapsed by default; null when the LLM gave none.

moved_from.description: Original location the LLM claims for a moved block.

impact.description: Code outside the diff this step may affect, shown inline as real code.

FragmentKind.description: Kind of a step (fragment) of a flow (brief §3).

Annotation.description: An annotation anchored to lines of a step (same side as the step); its range is a highlight.

was.description: Behaviour before the pull request; the hover tooltip shows only was → is.

text.description: The consequence, the flag's title or the note; null for a behaviour annotation.

flag.description:
Present exactly on a flag: its level (`unknown` for a flag stored before levels), scenario and what was
not checked.

AnnotationId.description: Identifier of an annotation, assigned by the server: `"<step>.a<n>"`, e.g. `f2.3.a1`.

AnnotationType.description: Type of an annotation inside a step.

oneOf.description: A risk the LLM states as a concrete scenario (brief §1 addendum 2026-11-18).

Basis.description: Whether a statement was read in the code or inferred.

oneOf.description: Read in the code; needs at least one evidence line.

Flag.description: The scenario of a flag; its title (the risk class, "Potential …") is the annotation's `text`.

level.description: red or yellow in agent output; unknown only on a flag stored before levels.

scenario.description: Ordered steps: who acts, the order of events, the outcome and its cost.

not_checked.description: One line: what was not reproduced or run.

FlagLevel.description: How strongly the LLM flags a risk: its own judgement, not checked.

oneOf.description: A likely defect or damage if the scenario is reachable.
Worth a look: plausible but weaker, or of lower cost.
A flag stored before flags had levels (a former question to check); never in new agent output.

Assessment.description: Assessment of a step at system scale (brief §3); evidence comes before it.

headline.description: What a production user or operator would notice.

risk.description: Risk band from the severity skill; never its numeric scores.

reason.description: Reason for the band, also for low.

basis_note.description: What the agent did: `Read: …` and, if it ran anything, `Ran: …`.

origin.description: Introduced by this pull request or pre-existing.

blocking.description: Whether an action is proposed before merge, as a follow-up, or neither.

smallest_correction.description: The smallest correction, or null; the agent may omit it for low.

Origin.description: Whether an issue was introduced by the pull request.

oneOf.description: Cannot be told from what was read.

Blocking.description: Merge impact of an assessed step.

oneOf.description: No blocking action or follow-up proposed; this is not an assurance of safety.
Should be resolved before this pull request merges.
Can be handled in a follow-up.

MovedFrom.description: Original location of a moved block at the base commit.

file.description: Repository-relative path at the base commit.

ImpactRef.description: Code outside the diff that a step may affect.

file.description: Repository-relative path at the head commit.

QuietRows.description: Quiet rows: never ranked above a flow.

unexplained.description:
Changed lines no flow explains ("Unexplained — read these yourself"); listed first. Removed lines
without a head location are base-side entries.

moves.description: Moves whose text is deterministically identical.

not_analysed.description: Material recognised by path or line rules.

UnexplainedRanges.description: Unexplained lines of one file on one side, with why the server left them out when it decided so.

reason.description:
Why the server did not send these lines to the LLM (deterministic); absent when the LLM did not
explain them.

UnexplainedReason.description: Why the server left Unexplained lines out of every LLM request.

oneOf.description: Not sent to the LLM: the request holding them would be larger than one prompt may be.

IdenticalMove.description:
A moved block whose text is identical after whitespace normalisation. The UI says "Body text identical"
and nothing more: identical text does not mean unchanged behaviour, and no call-site flow is linked in v1
(ADR-008).

from.description: Original block at the base commit.

to.description: New block at the head commit.

file_count.description: Number of files in the section.

NotAnalysedCategory.description: Section of material that is not analysed.

oneOf.description: Mechanical and generated material, lockfiles included.

NotAnalysedItem.description: One file (or line ranges of it) recognised by a rule; one item per file and side.

renderable.description: Whether the server can show code for this side and file; absent on older Tours.

rule_kind.description: Detector that actually matched; absent on older stored pre-passes.

side.description: `base` for a deleted file or removed lines, else `head`.

ranges.description: Matched changed lines on that side; null for the whole file.

rule.description: The matching rule or detector description.

oneOf.description: Comment-only lines recognised by a language lexer.
A generated-file marker in the header.

GithubThread.description: A GitHub review thread of the pull request.

line.description: Last line; null for file-level threads.

start_line.description: First line of a multi-line thread.

side.description: Diff side (GitHub LEFT = base, RIGHT = head); null for file-level threads.

author.description: Author login of the first comment.

step_id.description: The step the thread is located in, if any.

llm_status.description: LLM status for threads located in a flow's steps; null otherwise.

ThreadLlmStatus.description: LLM status of an existing GitHub review thread.

oneOf.description: The thread still applies to the current code.
The thread refers to code that no longer exists here.
The current code already addresses the thread.
